_what: cv15 ring-down spectra for the CORRECT (two_plane ground, the committed leg) and the issue-#740 PRE-FIX (one_plane ground) realizations, both built through cv15's PRODUCTION builder `build_rfx_sim(two_plane=...)` and extracted through its production `_harminv_f0()`.
_why: This fixture is the EVIDENCE for the scope limit pre-declared in docs/design_notes/20260901_patch_mode_identification_predeclaration.md section 5: the #740 vacuum ground cell rescales the whole cavity spectrum by a single factor, so it is invisible to the mode-resolved identification and to the audit's proposed mode-pair RATIO band alike. It is caught by assert_realized_stack (PR #768), whose exact refusal is recorded below. Keeping the numbers committed means the claim 'the pair gate closes #740' can be refuted without a solve.
